user.title: CFE bills from email
user.description: Connect the mailbox that receives the CFE bills (the CFDI XML attachments). For Gmail, use an app password.

data_description.password: A Gmail app password, not your account password.
data_description.folder: Mailbox folder that receives the bills, e.g. INBOX.
data_description.rpu: The 12-digit RPU printed on the bill.

reauth_confirm.title: Mailbox login failed
reauth_confirm.description: The mailbox rejected the login for {username}. Enter a new app password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the IMAP server or open the folder.
error.invalid_auth: The mailbox rejected the email address or app password.
error.invalid_rpu: The RPU must be exactly 12 digits.

abort.already_configured: This service number (RPU) is already set up.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Checks the mailbox for new CFE bills now.
